Job Description: 
 
 What you will be a part of: 
 At Saab, Inc., we constantly look ahead and push boundaries for what is considered technically possible. We collaborate with colleagues around the world who all share our challenge – to make the world a safer place.

Aviation stakeholders face a greater number of challenges and more complex demands than ever before. At Saab Inc., we continually find new ways to address these challenges and enable safe, predictable, and efficient operations. We go beyond existing solutions, pioneering new ideas and helping to set industry standards.
 
 Saab Inc delivers products that span operations, surveillance sensors, Air Traffic Control automation, collaborative decision making, and digital towers. Our solutions are trusted by air navigation service providers, airports and airlines at over 100 locations in more than 45 countries. As a global leading partner and provider of proven ATM solutions and services, we transform operations, turning innovative ideas into reality and supporting stakeholders from solution conception through long-term support.
 
 Your Role: 
 Do you want to work on a dynamic team of dedicated, enthusiastic employees with a reputation for integrity, quality, excellence, and teamwork?  Then this is the job for you, Saab currently has a need for Java Software Engineer in our East Syracuse, NY office.  You will be working alongside our System Engineering Team and other Software Engineers as they work toward improving tools that are used within the FAA.  We are looking for a Software Engineer with an interest in all aspects of the software development lifecycle.
 
 Compensation Range: $92,200 - $115,300
 The compensation range provided is a general guideline. When extending an offer, Saab, Inc. considers factors including (but not limited to) the role and associated responsibilities, location, and market and business considerations, as well as the candidate's work experience, key skills, and education/training.
 
 
 Skills and Experience: 
 
 Education/Experience: 
 Bachelor’s Degree (or higher) in computer science, software engineering or related discipline

 3+ years of related experience required
 

 Required Skills: 
 Strong Java programming skills

 Relational database experience, preferably PostgreSQL

 Strong LINUX environment skills including command line and scripting tools

 Object Oriented Analysis and Design skills

 Experience with Integrated Development Environments (e.g. Eclipse, IntelliJ)

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills

 Must be able to work in a dynamic team environment.

 Abiltiy to travel ( 
 Desired Skills: 
 Experience with unit test frameworks (e.g. Junit, GTest, JTest)

 Experience with software design patterns

 Experience using UML

 Experience with automated build systems (e.g. Maven, Bamboo, Gradle)

 Aviation and Defense systems background/domain interest

 Experience with Artificial Intelligence and AI-Assisted Development (Generative AI, LLMs, AI coding assistants, RAG, AI agents, prompt engineering, and AI MCP servers)

 Experience with Ansible Automation and authoring playbooks and roles for installing, maintaining, or upgrading platforms

 
 Citizenship Requirements: 
 Must be a U.S. citizen, Permanent Resident (green card holder), or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3). 
 
 Drug-Free Workplaces: 
 Saab is a federal government contractor and adheres to policies and programs necessary for sustaining drug-free workplaces. As a condition of employment, candidates will be required to pass a pre-employment drug screen.
 
 Benefits: 
 
 Saab provides an excellent working environment offering professional growth opportunities, competitive wages, work-life balance, a business casual atmosphere and comprehensive benefits.
 
 Highlights include:
 Medical, vision, and dental insurance for employees and dependents

 Generous paid time off, including 8 designated holidays

 401(k) with employer contributions

 Tuition assistance and student loan assistance

 Wellness and employee assistance resources

 Employee stock purchase opportunities

 Short-term and long-term disability coverage

 
 
 About Us: 
 
 Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world. In the U.S., Saab delivers advanced technology and systems, supporting the U.S. Armed Forces and the Federal Aviation Administration, as well as international and commercial partners. Headquartered in Syracuse, New York, the company has business units and local employees in ten U.S. locations.
 
 Saab is a company where we see diversity as an asset and offer unlimited opportunities for advancing in your career. We are also a company that respects each person’s needs and encourage employees to lead a balanced, rewarding life beyond work. Saab values diversity and is an Affirmative Action employer for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Saab is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, all qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran, disability status, or any other federal, state, or locally protected category.
